description: This is a localization (i18n) source file defining Norwegian translations for a chat application, including messages, labels, and functions for dynamic content.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Generates placeholder text based on the submit key, suggesting how to send messages and search instructions.

methods.name: Update.FoundUpdate
methods.description: Formats a message indicating a new version is found.

methods.name: Usage.SubTitle
methods.description: Displays current usage and total subscription amount.

methods.name: Prompt.Topic
methods.description: Generates a concise title summarizing the conversation.

methods.name: Prompt.Summarize
